### ExtensionTx

Present only inside a core-run write transaction (hooks, commands, `transact`).
Core runs these Effects synchronously inside the owner transaction; an
asynchronous boundary is a defect that stops the extension.

### AttentionRecipientSchema

```ts
const AttentionRecipientSchema: Struct<{
  agentId: NonEmptyString;
  sessionId: NonEmptyString;
  name: NonEmptyString;
}>;
```

The Agent Session that sent the work an item belongs to. The host derives it
from the accepted mail; it is the only party the item waits on until it is
escalated.

---

### AttentionItemSchema

```ts
const AttentionItemSchema: Struct<{
  id: NonEmptyString;
  kind: NonEmptyString;
  summary: NonEmptyString;
  since: Int;
  expiresAt: optional<Int>;
  inbox: optional<Literal<false>>;
  waitingOn: optional<
    Struct<{
      agentId: NonEmptyString;
      sessionId: NonEmptyString;
      name: NonEmptyString;
    }>
  >;
}>;
```

An extension-owned request for human attention; expiry is owned by its timer.
Items marked `inbox: false` remain visible without changing the inbox state. An
item with `waitingOn` waits on that Agent first and is never a person's inbox
item until it is escalated past every Agent.

### defineExtension()

```ts
function defineExtension(
  identity,
): ExtensionBuilderV0<
  Readonly<Record<never, never>>,
  Readonly<Record<never, never>>,
  Readonly<Record<never, never>>
>;
```

Begin with honest empty defaults; optional contributions are declared
explicitly. The version defaults to `0.0.0` and any SemVer, including a
pre-release, is valid. It is part of the extension's revision, which already
covers schemas, config and requested capabilities; a different version marks a
behaviour change those do not show, such as a fixed hook.

#### Parameters

| Parameter  | Type                                          |
| ---------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `identity` | [`ExtensionIdentityV0`](#extensionidentityv0) |

#### Returns

[`ExtensionBuilderV0`](#extensionbuilderv0)\<`Readonly`\<`Record`\<`never`,
`never`\>\>, `Readonly`\<`Record`\<`never`, `never`\>\>,
`Readonly`\<`Record`\<`never`, `never`\>\>\>
